title: The inverse eigenvalue problems for perturbed Bessel operator with mixed data
summary: We consider inverse eigenvalue problems for the perturbed Bessel operator in $L^{2}(0,1)$. (1) For the case where the angular-momentum quantum number $\ell\in\mathbb{N}\cup\{0\}$, we establish a uniqueness result for the inverse spectral problem by utilizing the closedness condition of a certain function system constructed based on the eigenvalues and the norming constants.
